aiResearchSummary.text: UpCodes is researching a method of searching building codes tailored to how codes are structured and written. The work described in Method of Searching Building Codes focuses on specialized steps for querying and comparing different building codes, aligning results with technical terms such as occupancy groups and construction types. This activity centers on building code search, comparison, and code intelligence for the architecture, engineering, and construction domain.
